dedupeText: psychedelic folk collage 70s aesthetic grainy film surreal collage hand lettering psychedelic folk halftone texture the golden dragon acts as a foreground frame for the central figures the floating rock in the upper right creates a diagonal tension with the figures the hand lettered text follows a curved path bridging the gap between the figures and the rock high saturation warm tones in the foreground contrast against the cool blue of the upper sky combine grainy film photography with halftone sky gradients and flat line art overlays to create a psychedelic folk aesthetic tied together by path following hand lettering

recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, high-contrast photographic collage featuring three men in eclectic attire, framed by a golden illustrated dragon and a floating rock, set against a gradient sky with a distinct halftone print texture.
coreVisualRelationships: The golden dragon acts as a foreground frame for the central figures.
The floating rock in the upper right creates a diagonal tension with the figures.
The hand-lettered text follows a curved path, bridging the gap between the figures and the rock.
High-saturation warm tones in the foreground contrast against the cool blue of the upper sky.
coreInvariants: Visible halftone dot pattern and film grain
A floating stone element in the upper right quadrant
A golden, line-drawn dragon silhouette weaving through the composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three men occupy the lower half of the frame in a medium-close-up shot, appearing at roughly equal scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man on the left wearing a dark wide-brimmed hat and bright orange scarf.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the figures, follows the dragon's tail upward, moves along the curved text to the floating rock, and back down through the sky gradient.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant is relatively open, occupied by a clear blue sky with a grainy texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan-blue sky gradient occupying the upper half.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep orange and red tones in the clothing and scarves.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow used for the dragon illustration and sunset horizon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground subjects with deep, crushed shadows; desaturated, grainy values in the background sky.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid clean digital gradients; must use noisy, analog-style transitions.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular, hand-drawn baseline following a curved path
Loops are tight and slightly compressed
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are elongated to emphasize the flow of the curve.

composition.relationshipToImage: floats above subjects in the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single organic script paired with complex illustrative elements.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, handwritten feel of the original.
Aligns with the era-specific aesthetic of the collage.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy 1970s film photo of three men in eclectic hats and patterned scarves, framed at the bottom by a golden line-art dragon. The background is a cyan-to-yellow sunset sky with a heavy halftone dot texture. A single textured rock floats in the upper right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom monolinear cursive lettering following an upward arc from the center-left toward the floating rock in the upper right.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone texture visible across the sky?
Does the text follow a curved path?
Is the dragon illustration rendered as a flat, golden line-art overlay?
Are the shadows on the figures deep and high-contrast?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; must look like a printed scan.
Ensure the dragon does not look 3D; it must remain a flat graphic element.
postGenerationChecks: Check for visible dot patterns in the sky gradient.
Ensure the floating rock has a distinct photographic texture compared to the sky.
Verify the hand-drawn quality of the script.
Confirm the 1970s color palette (cyan, gold, burnt orange).
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [grainy film photography] with [halftone sky gradients] and [flat line-art overlays] to create a [psychedelic folk] aesthetic, tied together by [path-following hand-lettering].
